name: air-whiteboard
description: Browser whiteboard driven by webcam hand tracking or a pointer. All processing stays on the device.

scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/deploy-headers.mjs dist
scripts.build:bench: npm run assets && vite build --mode bench --outDir dist-bench
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:bench && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
